# C-EQ 3.3 — Measured headphones and more Winamp

## ✨ New / Novedades
- **AutoEQ curves for 48 popular Bluetooth headphones** (Sony WH/WF-1000XM, AirPods Pro 2/Max, Galaxy Buds, Bose QC, JBL, Sennheiser Momentum, Beats, Pixel Buds, Nothing, Soundcore, Jabra, Audio-Technica…). The model is recognized by its Bluetooth name and the automatic mode and fixed profiles use its measured correction. / **Curvas de AutoEQ para 48 audífonos Bluetooth**: se reconoce el modelo por su nombre y se corrige su sonido.
- **The skin's PRESETS button works** on the Full Winamp wallpaper, and you can **import your old Winamp presets** (.eqf and winamp.q1). / **PRESETS del skin funciona** e **importa tus preajustes de Winamp**.
- **13 new presets**: Electronic, Hip-hop, Reggaeton, Metal, Jazz, Acoustic, R&B, Latin, Movies, Night, Less bass, Extra treble and Small speaker. / **13 preajustes nuevos**.
- **Player widget** with the Winamp skin, what's playing and its buttons. / **Widget del reproductor** con el skin.
- **Random skin**: every day or every time the screen turns on. / **Skin al azar**: cada día o al encender la pantalla.
- **Surround sound** on phones that allow it on all audio. / **Sonido envolvente** en los teléfonos que lo permiten.
- **New-version reminders without Internet**: a "Check for updates" button, alerts through Obtainium, and a reminder when your version is over 45 days old. C-EQ still has no Internet permission. / **Aviso de versión nueva sin Internet**.

## ⬇️ Install / Instalar
Download **C-EQ-3.3.apk** below (Android 8.0+). It installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings. / Se instala encima de las versiones anteriores sin perder tus ajustes.
